reconstruction.target: source-guided reconstruction of SSQR position-scoring transfer, not exact original checkpoint replication
reconstruction.primary_basis: published main JSON path positions1..n, explicit greedy reconstruction of unspecified generate defaults
reconstruction.paper_differences: paper describes positions0..n, sampled m10; original post-training generation config and weights unavailable
reconstruction.max_new_tokens_rationale: explicit 19 new tokens corresponding to modern default total length20 incl decoder start; not recovered original decoding
reconstruction.t5_checkpoint: local best92000 from completed 93750-step CODEnn run, train seed101; author code actual set_seed42
reconstruction.codebert: new completed2epoch pooler/raw-dot/full batch CE; source linear warmup/decay; source valid only checkpoint selection
reconstruction.prob: descending teacher-forced mean log probability of wrapped label including sentinels/EOS; declared operationalization
reconstruction.entr: ascending raw full-model-vocabulary mean entropy; sentinels/EOS included, padding excluded
reconstruction.short_query_rule: min(3, number of available positions), no identity padding

rand_estimand: per-query average of best3 RR over20 frozen uniform position permutations, no new T5 sampling

bm25.tokenization: ASCII lowercase alphanumeric words starting with a letter, camel/snake split

missing_input_policy: reject; no implicit deletion or fallback
multiplicity: four RQ1 contrasts across two retrievers; Holm cluster-t p-values; Bonferroni98.75% cluster percentile intervals
inference: development-only, group OOF; pilot and remaining groups also reported separately; no confirmation inference

power_plan.method: group-weighted delta cluster-sandwich variance; normal planning with conservative95% bootstrap variance
power_plan.confirmation_group_selection: frozen SHA256 order of reserved groups, sample size decided before any confirmation method effects

extension_reason: improve development variance/event estimates and evaluate same-pool direct gain selection

reuse.dense_corpus_vectors: reuse frozen pilot vectors; no code re-encoding
reuse.query_text_cache: reuse every exact existing text; encode new texts only

direct_gain.pool: same ENTR min(3,N) candidates for every selection comparison
direct_gain.label: candidate RR@100 minus original RR@100
direct_gain.fold_assignment: SHA256 group order round-robin; no outcomes
direct_gain.row_weight: 1 / query candidate count, normalized mean1 within training fold
direct_gain.forced_rule: maximum predicted gain within fixed ENTR pool; tie native selected rank then position
direct_gain.selective_rule: include NoRewrite with known score0; adopt only if maximum candidate score>0
direct_gain.structural_zero: candidate ranking identical to original implies known gain0; override model score to0
direct_gain.adoption: actual Top100 ranking differs from original; fallback restores original full ranking
direct_gain.other_models: prespecified development controls, not post-hoc winners
direct_gain.future_full_fit: save research-only all-D models after OOF; never use full-fit predictions to evaluate D

rq2_inference: descriptive OOF intervals conditional on fitted folds; not a proof of algorithm novelty or certified risk
confirmation_multiplicity: final joint RQ1/RQ2 family and policy must be bound before opening confirmation
power_transport: also report known D/H positive-query group-size distributions and homogeneous group-mean variance design-factor sensitivity; no guaranteed transport
